repo_notes.content: JellyFlam3 Server is a self-hosted generative media pipeline: flam3 renders flame-fractal genomes to H.264 MP4 loops, catalogs them in Jellyfin under /media/sheep/by-generation/, and streams to Roku (VoD + stills screensaver) and Kodi (video screensaver). The Raspberry Pi is the furnace (render factory); TVs/clients are the pasture (playback only).
repo_notes.author: Owner

repo_notes.content:
CANONICAL DOCS — read these first before inferring architecture from code alone:
- Architecture SoT: docs/Pi5_Flam3_VoD_Pipeline.md
- Guide index + phase status: docs/README.md

Do not treat README.md code comments or stale wiki as authoritative over the phase guides.

repo_notes.content:
REPO LAYOUT PRIORITIES for documentation:
- pipeline/ — Python render worker, Shears, Hammer, refactor, peering, flock artwork, idle gate, config
- scripts/ — operator shell/Python tools (healthcheck, smoke, packaging, jellyfin_id_dump, client_pack_presets)
- roku-channel/ — JellyFlam3 VoD BrightScript channel (manifest 1.0.26)
- roku-screensaver/ — Roku stills screensaver (manifest 1.0.6)
- kodi-screensaver/screensaver.jellyflam3/ — Kodi ES-dogma video screensaver add-on (0.2.6)

- configs/ — jellyflam3.yaml + hw profiles 16/08/04
- tests/ — pytest (~303 tests on Linux CI; GitHub Actions on push/PR + release)
- deploy/ — systemd units, peering templates
- .github/ — issue templates, Dependabot, release workflow
repo_notes.author: Owner

repo_notes.content: FLEET HOSTS (operator reference): Furnace Pis rpi-jellyflam3-{16,08,04}a at their LAN IPs; install path /opt/jellyflam3-server; user jellyflam3. Kodi pasture host (e.g. rpi-kodi-08a) on LibreELEC — no worker. Roku clients on the LAN. Jellyfin on furnace LAN IP :8096 — clients must use LAN IP, never 127.0.0.1.
repo_notes.author: Owner

repo_notes.content: JELLYFIN FLOCK QUERY QUIRK (critical): Jellyfin 10.x ParentId=Sheep library + Recursive Movie/Video often returns a PARTIAL flock (e.g. 1 of 6) when MP4s live under by-generation/{gen}/ child folders. All clients (Roku VoD JellyfinTask.brs, Roku SS StillsTask.brs, Kodi jellyfin_flock.py, scripts/jellyfin_id_dump.py) MUST walk child Folder items and merge/dedupe — empty-only fallback is insufficient. Sideload Roku 1.0.26 / 1.0.6 and Kodi 0.2.6+.
repo_notes.author: Owner

repo_notes.content: SECRETS AND CONFIG: Never document or commit secrets.env, filled jellyflam3.yaml, or API keys. Reference secrets.env / JELLYFIN_API_KEY only. Sheep library ParentId must point at Sheep virtual folder (path /media/sheep/by-generation), NOT /media/sheep mount root. Keep Rework Poster library separate (/media/sheep/_refactor-preview).
repo_notes.author: Owner

repo_notes.content: ROKU CONSTRAINTS: Developer mode allows ONE sideloaded package per device — VoD channel and screensaver alternate; registry JellyFlam3 keys survive zip swap. Furnace-built zips embed registry/jellyflam3-presets.json via scripts/client_pack_presets.py. Commercial filtering is client-side (isCommercialSafe); never pass Tags= to Jellyfin Items API (AND semantics empty flock). shuffleFlock=false reloops one selected sheep in ambient mode — distinguish list size from playback loop behavior.
repo_notes.author: Owner

repo_notes.content: IDLE GATE: jellyflam3-idlegate pauses worker when Jellyfin reports active TV playback (Roku Client=JellyFlam3). Roku Screensaver and Kodi screensaver use Client=JellyFlam3-Screensaver so gate stays open during stills/video screensaver. healthcheck.sh and bringup_check.sh fail closed on bad units, missing gate status, Opt In without live Syncthing+Tailscale.
repo_notes.author: Owner

repo_notes.content: DEFERRED / OUT OF SCOPE (do not document as shipped): Continuous live HLS from shuffled MP4s (dropped). Gold Sheep / paid ES masters (never ingest). LLM pedigree, DeepDream, full social flock network (aspirational). Kodi loop→edge→loop post-launch (edges not in v0.3.x). Channel Store / private Roku publish post-launch.
repo_notes.author: Owner

repo_notes.content: TESTING: python3 -m pytest tests/ -q (~3s local; ~303 tests Linux CI). Fleet uses apt python3-pytest. smoke_render.sh and hls_smoke.sh are Pi/lab scripts not pytest. CI: .github/workflows/tests.yml + release.yml (tag push). ensure_exec_bits.sh --check on every CI run.
repo_notes.author: Owner
